gates.evidence: Image generation in the Image Creation Hub is a standard feature and the proposal includes no NSFW incentives or content.
The reward is granted for playing a mini-game, not for clicking ads or installing apps.
The proposal offers a reward when the quota is depleted, rather than threatening content deletion or loss.
The storyboard shows an offer screen (ns1) with 'Play Now' and 'No thanks' buttons.
The offer explicitly states: 'Play a 15-second game with Luzia to get 1 free AI image generation credit.'
The offer includes a 'No thanks' button that returns the user to the Image Creation Hub (s10).
The trigger is specifically when the usage quota (r3) is depleted, which is a hard block boundary.
The eligibility is explicitly restricted to 'Non-paying users'.

scores.evidence: The reward is offered exactly when the user hits the usage limit in the Image Creation Hub, which is the precise moment of need.
The solution is additive (adds credits) and keeps the user in flow. Playing with the character is a native, in-world action.
The reward is capped at 3 credits per day, ensuring usage remains limited and non-subscribers do not gain unlimited generation capability.
The cost to serve ($0.0250) is significantly higher than the estimated net revenue per view ($0.0063). The proposal fails to achieve break-even.
Image generation is a core loop function in Luzia; hitting usage limits is a common experience for free users.
The proposal maps clearly to SIM-RWD units with a logical patch and SSV-ready grant path.
Uses the specific app screen (s10), resource (r3), and character (Luzia) from the digest.
Includes a strict 3-per-day cap and a 30-minute cooldown, preventing nagging.
Includes primary metrics (image generation volume), guardrails (paid conversion), and a holdout design.

requiredChanges: Adjust the reward bundle to require two completed views for one image credit (a 2:1 ratio) to align with unit economics, or utilize a lower-cost model if available.
Update the offer copy to reflect the new bundle requirements (e.g., 'Watch 2 ads to earn 1 credit').
parsed.topConcern: The unit economics are unsustainable: the cost to serve the image generation ($0.0250) is roughly four times higher than the expected net revenue from a US rewarded view ($0.0063).
